violations.text: The air conditioning unit (stockroom B) was observed in poor repair, leaking onto floor at drip pan. PIC stated work order is on place and scheduled for service on 8/19/26. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026
Beverage bottles were observed stored on a shelf that is not 6 inches above the floor in the stock room. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 04/24/2025
